Description: As an instructor, I want to view the enrolled students and roll numbers so that I know who to mark. Acceptance criteria: roster shows each student's name and roll number; the empty roster state is clear.

As an instructor, I want to mark each student present or absent so that I can record attendance for a session. Acceptance criteria: each student can be marked present or absent; current choice is visibly selected; changing the choice updates the summary.

As an instructor, I want to see present, absent, and unmarked totals so that I can quickly review the session. Acceptance criteria: totals match roster statuses; unmarked students are counted separately; total enrolled is visible.

As an instructor, I want to search students and filter the roster by attendance status so that I can find records quickly. Acceptance criteria: search matches names and roll numbers; status filter can be combined with search; no matches shows a helpful empty state.
As an instructor, I want to mark a student late so that attendance reflects arrival status. Acceptance criteria: late is a separate status; late count appears in summary; filters include late.

As an instructor, I want attendance to persist for each selected date so that I can return to the session later. Acceptance criteria: changing dates shows that date's records; changes persist after reload in the same browser; clearing demo data requires confirmation.

Summary: Apply customer request for late status and date sessions
Description: As the Product Owner, I want late arrivals and separate dated sessions after review feedback so that the increment reflects instructor needs. Acceptance criteria: late status and date selection are implemented; summary/filter update; previous sessions remain separate.
